excerpt: The U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) has granted "Critical Decision-Zero" (CD-0) status to the sPHENIX project [on January 13, 2017]; CD-0 states there is a 'mission need' for the capabilities described by the proposal and enables conceptual design and R&D to proceed.
title: sPHENIX Gets CD0 for Upgrade to Experiment Tracking the Building Blocks of Matter
